text: {"527":{"about":["rustc_expand"],"refers":[],"why":"The `mbe` module in `rustc_expand` implements declarative macro expansion."},"528":{"about":["rustc_expand"],"refers":[],"why":"Metavariables are a core concept implemented by the declarative-macro machinery."},"529":{"about":["rustc_expand"],"refers":["rustc_ast"],"why":"Macro expansion binds metavariables to token trees, while token-tree representations are defined by `rustc_ast`."},"530":{"about":["rustc_ast"],"refers":[],"why":"`rustc_ast` defines compiler syntax tokens and token streams, including grammar-level token units."},"531":{"about":["rustc_ast"],"refers":[],"why":"Punctuation is part of the token representation provided by `rustc_ast`."}}
